s2.ptxt: Using SST, tap in a new breather plug until it contacts the transfer case.
Install a new breather oil deflector to the transfer case with the 2 bolts.

s-1.ptxt: Install Transfer Ring Gear Mounting Case

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a press, press the transfer ring gear mounting case into the transfer ring gear.

atten3.ptxt: Do not apply load to the ring gear tooth surface.

s2.ptxt: Using SST, install a new shaft snap ring.

s-1.ptxt: Install Ring Gear Mounting Case Bearing

s2.ptxt: Install new ring gear mounting case washer No.2 to transfer case cover No.1.

atten4.ptxt: Install a washer of the same thickness as before disassembly.

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a press, press the ring gear mounting case bearing (outer race) into transfer case cover No.1.

item.ptxt: Press in until the bearing and washer are in close contact with the end face.
Do not apply load to the bearing rolling surface.

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a press, press the ring gear mounting case bearing (inner race) onto the transfer ring gear mounting case.

atten3.ptxt: Do not deform the bearing cage.

s2.ptxt: Apply hypoid gear oil SX to the mounting case bearing.

s-1.ptxt: Install Ring Gear Mounting Case Bearing

s2.ptxt: Install a new transfer ring gear mounting case washer to the transfer case.

atten4.ptxt: Install a washer of the same thickness as before disassembly.

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a press, press the ring gear mounting case bearing (outer race) into the transfer case.

item.ptxt: Press in until the bearing and washer are in close contact with the end face.
Do not apply load to the bearing rolling surface.

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a press, press the ring gear mounting case bearing (inner race) onto the transfer ring gear mounting case.
Apply hypoid gear oil SX to the mounting case bearing.
Install the transfer output shaft washer to the transfer driven pinion.

s-1.ptxt: Install Transfer Driven Pinion Bearing Front

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a press, press the transfer driven pinion bearing FR onto the transfer driven pinion.

atten3.ptxt: Do not apply load to any part other than the inner race and the flat portion of the driven pinion.

s-1.ptxt: Install Transfer Output Rear Shaft Dust Deflector

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a press, press the transfer output rear shaft dust deflector onto the transfer output shaft.

atten3.ptxt: Press in until the dust deflector is in close contact with the end face.

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a press, press the transfer driven pinion onto the transfer output shaft.

atten3.ptxt: Do not apply load to any part other than the flat portions of the driven pinion and output shaft flange.

s2.ptxt: Secure the output shaft in a vise between aluminum plates.
Using a socket wrench (30mm), install a new transfer gear nut to the output shaft.
Install a new O-ring to the transfer driven pinion.

item.ptxt: Make sure that the O-ring is not damaged or twisted.
Securely install it to the corner of the bearing.

s2.ptxt: Install the transfer output shaft to the transfer case with the 5 bolts.

atten3.ptxt: Make sure that the O-ring is not damaged or twisted.

s2.ptxt: Install the nut to the stud bolt.

atten4.ptxt: The propeller shaft installation nut can be used as the nut.

s2.ptxt: Using a torque wrench, inspect the turning torque of the driven pinion (driven pinion preload).

atten3.ptxt: Before measuring, turn the shaft forward and in reverse several times to seat the bearing.

item.ptxt: Install the torque wrench as shown in the illustration.
Measure the turning torque at approximately 60 r/min (1 revolutions/1 seconds).

s2.ptxt: Apply a thin, even coat of red lead to all teeth on both sides of the transfer ring gear tooth surfaces.
Install the transfer ring gear to the transfer case.
Install the transfer case cover No.1 to the transfer case with the 8 bolts.
Insert a dial indicator through the transfer case plug No.2 hole and place it perpendicular to the tip of the ring gear tooth surface.
While holding the transfer output shaft by hand, turn the transfer ring gear mounting case back and forth by hand to measure the backlash between the ring gear and driven pinion.

atten3.ptxt: Inspect at 3 locations around the circumference of the ring gear.

s2.ptxt: If the result is not as specified, select a ring gear mounting case washer (for backlash adjustment) and transfer ring gear mounting case washer No.2 (for preload adjustment) from the table, and reinstall them to bring the value within the specification.

table.title: Case Washer No.2 Types (for Preload Adjustment)

s2.ptxt: Install the nut to the stud bolt.

atten4.ptxt: The propeller shaft installation nut can be used as the nut.

s2.ptxt: Using a torque wrench, measure the turning torque (total preload) with the driven pinion and ring gear tooth surfaces in contact.

specitem.ptxt: Total preload = Driven pinion + 0.28 to 0.79N*m{2.9 to 8.1kgf*cm}

atten3.ptxt: Before measuring, turn the shaft forward and in reverse several times to seat the bearing.

item.ptxt: Install the torque wrench as shown in the illustration.
Measure the turning torque at approximately 60 r/min (1 revolutions/1 seconds).

s2.ptxt: If the result is not as specified, select a transfer ring gear mounting case washer No.2 (for preload adjustment) from the table, and reinstall it to bring the value within the specification.

table.title: Case Washer No.2 Types (for Preload Adjustment)

s-1.ptxt: Adjust Ring Gear and Driven Pinion Tooth Contact

s2.ptxt: Turn the transfer output shaft forward and in reverse several times.
Remove the transfer ring gear and check the tooth contact.

item.ptxt: Check the tooth contact pattern at 4 or more locations around the circumference of the ring gear.
When replacing the washers (for backlash adjustment, preload adjustment and tooth contact adjustment), reapply red lead.

atten4.ptxt: The pattern shown by the red lead is the tooth contact position.

s2.ptxt: If there is face contact or flank contact, perform the following.

s3.ptxt: Adjust by moving the ring gear using transfer ring gear mounting case washer No.2 (for preload adjustment) and the ring gear mounting case washer (for backlash adjustment).

s2.ptxt: For heel contact and toe contact, perform the following procedure.

s3.ptxt: Select a transfer output shaft washer (for tooth contact adjustment) from the table, and adjust by moving the driven pinion.

table.title: Output Shaft Washer Types (for Tooth Contact Adjustment)

s2.ptxt: If the tooth contact has been adjusted, perform the backlash inspection, preload inspection and tooth contact inspection again.
Using a plastic hammer, install the straight pin in the position shown in the illustration.
Using a chisel and hammer, stake the pinion gear nut.

atten3.ptxt: Stake along the entire staking groove.

s2.ptxt: Install the output shaft to the transfer case with the 5 bolts.

atten3.ptxt: Be careful that the O-ring is not damaged, twisted or cut.

s2.ptxt: Install transfer case cover No.1.

s3.ptxt: Using a scraper and wire brush, clean off the seal packing adhering to the transfer case and transfer case cover No.1, and then remove any oil with cleaning solvent or equivalent.

atten3.ptxt: Do not damage the installation surfaces.

s3.ptxt: Apply seal packing 1281 continuously in a bead (diameter 2-3 mm) to the transfer case in the position shown in the illustration.

atten3.ptxt: Install the case within 10 minutes after applying seal packing.

s3.ptxt: Install transfer case cover No.1 with the 8 bolts.

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a hammer, tap in a new oil seal to the standard depth.

item.ptxt: Tap the oil seal in evenly so that it goes in straight.
Do not tap the oil seal in too far.

s2.ptxt: Apply a thin coat of MP grease No.2 to the lip of the oil seal.

s-1.ptxt: Install Transfer Case Oil Seal RH

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a hammer, tap in a new oil seal to the case until it reaches the specified depth.

specitem.ptxt: 7.5 to 8.5 mm (from the transfer case end surface)

item.ptxt: Tap the oil seal in evenly so that it goes in straight.
Do not tap the oil seal in too far.

s2.ptxt: Apply a thin coat of MP grease No.2 to the lip of the oil seal.
Using a 10 socket hexagon wrench, install transfer case plug No.2 (filler plug) with a new gasket.
Using a 10 socket hexagon wrench, install the transfer drain plug with a new gasket.
Install transfer case plug No.1 with a new gasket.
Remove the transfer assembly from the overhaul attachment.

s-1.ptxt: Install Transfer & Transaxle Setting Stud Bolt

s2.ptxt: Install the 4 stud bolts to the transfer case in the positions shown in the illustration.

atten3.ptxt: Install the stud bolts so that the end with the shorter thread is on the transfer side.
